newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar firms over key level.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar firms over key level.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were firmer in thin midsession trade Wednesday amid spread buying and outright interest in the July contract, market sources said.
Early trade buying in the July/October and October/March spreads prompted commission house buying, which lifted July over key 11.11 cents, the recent high hit on May 14.
The contract climbed to a high of 11.13 cents, where producer selling emerged to block further gains.
"The market is under significant pressure," a broker said, adding that buy stops are rumored to be resting around 11.14 cents.
The next level of resistance was seen at 11.20 cents in July.
At 1130 EDT, July stood at 11.12 cents per lb, up 0.07 cents, having ranged from 11.13 to 11.07 cents. The outer months were trading 0.05 to 0.03 firmer.
Volume was estimated at 9,641 lots as of 1100 EDT. Activity is expected to thin throughout the day ahead of the annual U.S. Cane Sugar Refiners' Association dinner, trading sources said.
